description: Headwind = V × cos(θ) and crosswind = V × sin(θ), where θ is the angle between the runway heading and the wind direction, from FAA-H-8083-25C Chapter 11. Enter a runway number 1–36 or a heading in degrees. Optional gust. Educational only, not for navigation or dispatch.

gust.description: Optional gust speed in the same unit

wind_direction_deg.description: Direction the wind is FROM, 0–360, same reference as the runway

name: crosswind
title: Crosswind and headwind components from runway and wind
